scope: Additive authenticated bundled-libdwarf closure for current McKernel image configuration

failure_family.symptom: CMake selected bundled libdwarf but the retained candidate did not materialize its nested gitlink

behavior: Creates a fresh non-shared local checkout of the full exact commit without network access
Binds candidate, IHK, base-manifest hash, commit, tree, 412 tracked paths, Git modes, raw unfiltered blob IDs, SHA-256 bytes and 21 Git metadata files
Rejects external gitdirs/common dirs, alternates, shallow repositories, replacement refs, dirty or ignored extras, symlinks, special files and nested gitlinks
Mounts the separately disjoint checkout read-only at the exact nested /src gitlink path while leaving the retained candidate and host output unchanged
Revalidates the closure before and after execution, including configure/build failure paths

tests.adversarial_case: core.autocrlf plus skip-worktree cannot substitute CRLF bytes for the pinned LF blob

reviews.strategy: PASS: exact bundled gitlink closure is preferred over changing to system libdwarf-devel
reviews.source: PASS_SOURCE_CORRECTION after closing checkout, environment, raw-byte, index/tree, metadata and failure-path gaps
reviews.namespace: PASS_SOURCE_NAMESPACE for active exportset23 with exportset22 retired

acceptance: Source and fixture evidence only; no build, guest, application or production gate moves.
